text:
jess: rolled v3.1.2 to prod at 09:12 UTC. running quick smoke. seeing a small p95 bump on /api/v1/generate from two hosts. no 5xxs yet. tagging oncall.
deploy-bot: deployment v3.1.2 completed by jess. smoke summary: 16/16 checks OK, 1 warn. link: https://deploys.internal/release/3.1.2 :rocket:
ops-bot: alert: gen-route p95 > 450ms for 00:00:20. affected hosts: gen-node-02, gen-node-11. disk io noise noted on gen-node-11.
mike: oncall here. quick question — is this the new quant config (q8_eco) or variant change?
jess: yes, this release bumped embed/generate route to q8_eco for cost savings. no infra changes. plan: 1) run tokenizer+kv warmup on both nodes 2) shift 12% traffic off gen-node-02/11 for 4m 3) re-run smoke. pin to q8_standard if p95>700 or error rate >0.5%
mike: sounds good. start warmup and partial reroute. also add a short note in release notes.
ops-bot: routing: 12% traffic shifted off gen-node-02,gen-node-11. warmup job started.
jess: warmup job: {job: kv-prefill, targets: [gen-node-02,gen-node-11], rate: 180rps, duration: 3m}
mike: re-run smoke after warmup: p95 -> 160ms, errors 0/500. looks stable. will monitor 30m.
jess: updating release notes: "postdeploy: applied kv warmup on gen-node-02/11 for transient p95 spike after q8_eco switch; stabilized, no rollback."
deploy-bot: watch entry created for release:v3.1.2 - watch:30m - actions:[warmup+partial-reroute, pin-if-regress]. :white_check_mark:
